Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

The Security Governance, Risk and Compliance (SGRC) team within InfoSec manages cybersecurity risk across Block. Its Sourcing Security Assurance (SSA) team assesses third-party software, services, and integrations, enabling informed decisions about vendors, data, and access.

As a Senior Sourcing Security Assurance Analyst, you will lead complex, risk-based provider assessments, evaluating products, integrations, data handling, and controls beyond vendor certifications and translating findings into practical recommendations.

Reporting to the Cybersecurity Risk, Vulnerability, and Vendor Security Assurance Lead, you will work with business owners, Procurement and Strategic Sourcing, Security, Privacy, Legal, and other partners. This senior individual contributor role requires independent judgment, stakeholder influence, mentorship, and scalable assurance.

You Will

  • Lead complex third-party assessments from intake and scoping through evidence review, risk analysis, documentation, and recommendation. Manage competing reviews and communicate progress and dependencies.
  • Assess the provider, product, and use case, including business criticality, data sensitivity, deployment, integrations, access, and existing use across Block. Apply the Provider Assurance Level framework to focus risk-based diligence.
  • Review questionnaires, SOC 2 Type II reports, ISO 27001 certifications, penetration test summaries, and policies; assess evidence relevance, identify gaps, and follow up with vendors. Document evidence, risks, limitations, and recommended dispositions or mitigations. Escalate exceptions and risk decisions to their owners without accepting risk on their behalf.
  • Assess identity and access management, SSO, OAuth, APIs, service accounts, cloud and on-premises deployments, browser extensions, and AI features, including data flows, permissions, and compensating controls. Engage security, privacy, and governance partners for specialized reviews.
  • Support ongoing assurance through risk-based reassessments, material-change reviews, vendor inventories and baselines, and monitoring signals. Revisit prior findings and coordinate follow-up.
  • Triage third-party incidents and breach notifications, assess relevance to Block, and coordinate escalation with incident response, Privacy, and other partners. Work across teams to resolve questions and identify practical security requirements and mitigations while supporting business timelines.
  • Improve assurance quality through playbooks, assessment methods, reporting, metrics, and automation opportunities. Mentor teammates and share knowledge across a geographically distributed team.

You Have

  • 6+ years of experience in security assessment, third-party security or vendor risk management, security assurance, or a related field, including ownership of complex assessments.
  • Experience interpreting SOC 2 reports, ISO 27001 materials, penetration tests, and questionnaires; identifying gaps; and applying frameworks such as NIST and PCI DSS proportionately.
  • Working knowledge of identity, authentication, authorization, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, APIs, and service accounts; experience assessing data handling, cloud or on-premises deployments, security architecture, and compensating controls.
  • Ability to synthesize incomplete or conflicting information, make well-reasoned recommendations, and explain technical risk to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Experience working with vendors and cross-functional partners, managing an assessment portfolio and priorities, and improving processes, documenting practices, or mentoring teammates.

You May Also Have

  • Experience assessing AI-enabled products, SaaS applications, browser extensions, or other workforce software integrations.
  • Experience with platforms such as Zip, OneTrust, Jira, or Grip; or using data, reporting, scripting, or automation to improve assurance workflows and stakeholder visibility.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, or CRISC, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience working across distributed teams and explaining security findings to senior stakeholders.

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We are the global leader in tokenized treasuries, tokenized stocks and ETFs, and are building the future of institutional-grade financial services onchain.

Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role

We’re looking for a Solutions professional to help grow Ondo Finance’s developer ecosystem in the Americas. This role will focus on supporting developers, crypto exchanges, and wallet providers working with Ondo’s APIs for minting and redeeming tokenized assets.

You will be a bridge between our engineering, product, GTM teams and external developers, helping partners succeed in building on Ondo while advocating for their needs internally. The role requires a strong technical foundation, the ability to work independently across cultures and time zones, and excellent communication skills.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a technical point of contact for developers, exchanges, and wallet partners integrating with Ondo products.
  • Provide hands-on support to partners on minting, redemption, and integration workflows for tokenized stocks and RWAs.
  • Create developer-facing resources such as documentation, tutorials, code samples, and FAQ guides.
  • Foster and grow Ondo’s developer presence
  • Gather feedback from partners and developers; relay insights to product and engineering teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, business development, and operations to ensure seamless partner experience.
  • Represent Ondo at regional hackathons, conferences, and community events when needed.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering or related experience (Developer Relations, Developer Support). Web3 experience preferred.
  • Strong understanding of crypto infrastructure, especially self-custodial wallets, exchanges, and API integrations.
  • Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and thrive in a distributed, multicultural team spanning multiple time zones.
  • Technical proficiency (software engineering background preferred) — capable of understanding code, debugging integration issues, and communicating with engineers.

Nice to haves

  • Experience working directly with crypto exchanges or wallets on API integrations.
  • Familiarity with blockchain protocols, smart contracts, or L1/L2 ecosystems.
  • EVM smart contract debugging experience is a strong plus

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Robinhood is hiring an Events Marketing Manager to own the cohesive marketing plans for its growing roster of events. This is an amplification role. You'll take the approved event strategy and build the marketing plan and messaging for each workstream (RSVP, livestream, and post-event) to get people to register or buy tickets, tune in to the livestream, and keep them talking after the event ends. Your plans will cover all the major channels (paid and organic social, email and lifecycle marketing, PR), and you’ll also shape how the brand shows up on-site. This is not an event production or logistics role. Venue, travel, F&B, and on-site operations sit with other members of the Events team. We are looking for someone who thinks in funnels, channels, audiences, and reach, and who is just as comfortable owning a brief as running a daily performance check-in.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

Event Marketing Strategy

  • Build the event marketing and amplification plan across 3 core workstreams (RSVP/ticket sales, livestream, and post-event), including goals, audience targeting, messaging hierarchy, asset needs, and channel mix.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment on the amplification plan with Channel Leads (Social, Lifecycle Marketing, Comms) and Marketing Leadership); own briefing to Creative team for assets.
  • Align with Product Managers on event-related product announcements and promotions, and incorporate into the event marketing plan and keynote.
  • Partner with Senior Brand Manager on ticketing/RSVP and pricing approach, and manage the registration types, flows and nurture strategy. 
  • Collaborate with the Sponsorship Lead to define and execute the sponsor marketing strategy and deliverables included in each sponsor package (social, email, comms, etc).
  • Support Program Manager on Legal & Compliance review of marketing assets.

Promotional Plan Execution & Optimization

  • Execute the approved marketing plan across all channels with one promotional calendar that covers the full event arc (3 workstreams); ensures all assets go live on schedule and are on message.
  • Manage paid social planning and optimization, including budget tracking, platform partner relationships, and in-flight optimization against RSVP, ticket, and livestream tune-in goals.
  • Partner with the organic social team and Creative on teaser sequencing, social-first creative, and posting cadence to build momentum and reach.

On-Site Branding & Marketing

  • Own the on-site branding strategy along the attendee journey (e.g., signage, branded environments, swag); includes brief creation.
  • Build marketing plans for cross-functional on-site activations, such as CX and Research, in partnership with their teams. 

Content Capture & Post-Event Promotion

  • Build the content pipeline to drive post-event momentum and reach: determine the post-event promotion plan that turns keynotes, sessions, and on-site moments into clips, highlights, and recap content that extends the moment and drives reach after the event ends.
  • Partner with the content capture and social teams for the on-site content capture, reviews, and go-live process. 

Reporting & Measurement

  • Set goals for each workstream and channel (RSVPs and attendance, livestream views and CPV, engagement), benchmarked against prior events.
  • Track daily registration counts, cohort conversion, and channel performance to forecast attendance and optimize in flight.
  • Own the post-event program report: consolidate channel results against goals and prior events, with key learnings per work stream and attendee survey results (in partnership with Research). 
  • Lead the marketing retro with channel partners and turn the learnings into recommendations for the next event.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing (events, brand, social, or content marketing) within a consumer-facing company; financial services a plus.
  • Proven track record of building and executing integrated marketing plans across paid, owned, and earned channels (e.g., paid social, email and lifecycle, PR), with strong organic social expertise and a record of optimizing against performance goals.
  • Hands-on experience driving ticket sales, registration, or attendance for events, including promotions, audience targeting, and conversion optimization.
  • Proven track record driving awareness and large-scale reach for events or campaigns (e.g., livestream viewership, social and earned reach), with metrics to back it up.
  • Experience driving on-site branding and brand activations at events a plus.
  • Comfort using data (e.g., registration, campaign performance, and audience insights) to forecast, optimize, and report on results.
  • Clear, confident communicator with experience writing briefs and managing creative and agency partners through execution.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives, aligning channel leads and stakeholders around a shared plan, including Legal & Compliance review processes (ideally in a regulated industry).
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong project management skills and the ability to manage complex workflows in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter and problem-solver who thrives in ambiguity and adapts quickly as priorities evolve.
  • Based in the U.S. (NYC or SF preferred), with travel required for key events throughout the year.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.

About us:

Luno has spent over a decade making digital assets safe to own. Since 2013, we’ve helped millions of people around the world buy, store and invest in crypto, working with regulators in every market and holding all customer crypto 1:1. That discipline built the licences, banking relationships, custody and compliance machinery that the next era of this market will run on
The financial system is moving on-chain. Stablecoins are the only digital asset class operating at institutional scale today, and while 98% of supply is dollar-pegged, roughly half of global payment flows are not. That gap is the opportunity, and it is largest in exactly the markets Luno has spent twelve years building in.

About the team

You will join the Product team building GTXN, Luno’s global settlement business. GTXN focuses on institutional payments: the collections, pay-outs, virtual account and conversion products that let businesses and financial institutions move money in and out of emerging markets through one integration. You will work with dedicated engineering and UX partners to build and run the payment products that GTXN customers depend on.

GTXN has the ambition to operate like a startup so this role needs flexibility and a balance between systems thinking and speed: you will design for the long term and still ship quickly.

The role in a nutshell

You will turn GTXN’s strategy into the payments roadmap, work with Engineering and Payment Partnerships to build the money movement products customers run on, such as collections, pay-outs and virtual accounts, and make sure every payment is fast, reliable, affordable and controlled.

Your mission will be

  • Own the GTXN payments roadmap: Work closely with Commercial and business owners to turn the GTXN and business strategy into the payments roadmap. Lead discovery through to launch and adoption, enabling the payment flows customers need
  • Define what our rails and providers must deliver: Set the product requirements for every new payment flow or corridor
  • Work closely with Payment Partnerships: Lead the product and engineering input to provider selection, and keep the corridor backlog aligned with their provider pipeline
  • Launch new corridors and currencies: Take new corridors from customer need to live product. Turn requirements into an integration scope that Engineering can build from without guesswork, and turn each launch into a playbook that makes the next one faster.
  • Drive product decisions with data: Define the right measures for institutional payments, so you can see where they succeed, stall or cost too much, and decide what we build, fix and prioritise
  • Lead the cross-functional effort to make payments reliable, operable and trusted. Define the product behind routing, reconciliation, failure handling and internal tooling, supporting Operations 
  • Shorten the path from signed customer to first live payment: Shape the customer implementation journey. Work hands-on with new customers to plan their integration, find where activation loses customers, and turn what you learn into repeatable integration capabilities.

A little about you

  • You are a senior Product Manager in payments, banking, a regulated fintech or a crypto business. 
  • You have built institutional or B2B money movement products, such as collections, pay-outs, account-to-account transfers or virtual accounts, including integrating with and managing banks or payment providers
  • You understand how a payment works end to end: local and cross-border rails, settlement, reconciliation, returns and failures, and what each step costs
  • You are technically comfortable where product meets integration: the transaction lifecycle, ledger and reconciliation basics, API integration design, bank and provider APIs, payment messaging, retries and failure handling, in enough depth to make good trade-offs with engineers
  • You are rigorous with data: success rates, failure reasons, time to settle and cost per payment. You can find where a flow leaks, quantify what it costs, and prioritise accordingly
  • You understand the commercials of payments: pricing, unit economics and how cost flows through to margin
  • You write a clear integration scope, and you communicate precisely with the engineering partners you lead the work with
  • You manage stakeholders as a craft: keeping payment operations, treasury, compliance, banks and customers aligned, communicating risks early
  • You can balance speed with compliant, secure and trusted payments, and hold a position on customer experience when a control or regulatory requirement pulls the other way
  • Experience with payments in emerging markets, in Africa or Southeast Asia, or with multi-currency, cross-border or stablecoin settlement is a strong advantage
  • You use AI as part of how you work and can show where it has changed your output, not just your tooling. Exposure to AI-enabled back-office operations is a plus.

Life at Luno:

  • Remote but reachable work policy gives you the freedom to choose between working from home or the office.
  • Plus the option to buy and sell up to 5 days leave
  • Improve body and mind, with excellent private medical insurance
  • Enjoy peace of mind with Luno's comprehensive retirement fund and essential risk benefits.
  • Access to Learnably and our additional learning platforms for your personal and professional development
  • 6 months primary care-giver leave
  • Paw-ternity leave for your furry friend
  • Annual Inspiration Day in addition to your annual leave which increases based on your length of service! 
  • A collaborative, friendly work community, with regular social events and virtual cooking, dancing, drawing and house planting classes hosted by our Lunauts
  • Free lunch and snacks
  • 0 fees up to a certain amount with Luno from the day you start.*

*Offer only available on Luno Instant Buy, not Luno Exchange

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

This role sits within SOX Compliance and is the senior technical authority for IT controls in the SOX program. You will set the strategy for ITGCs, IT application controls, and the controls over private key management and digital asset custody. Internal Audit independently tests the controls you own.

You will own the ITGC SOX program, building the control framework, testing approach, and evidence standards from the ground up. This is a hands-on role with real program ownership at a crypto exchange. The technology stack spans blockchain-native infrastructure, digital asset custody systems, and on-chain and off-chain processing, and engineering changes at a pace most companies never see. The systems are complex, the deployments are frequent, and the controls are consequential.

 

The opportunity

  • Strategy & program ownership

    • Own the enterprise IT SOX strategy and roadmap, covering ITGC, ITAC, and digital asset and key management controls across all in-scope entities and jurisdictions.

    • Define the scoping methodology and risk assessment for IT SOX, including in-scope applications, infrastructure, wallet and custody systems, and third-party and service-organization dependencies.

    • Set control design standards and own the control framework. Design controls that fit modern engineering practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, cloud) and don’t slow them down.

    • Set the standard for management testing and evidence. Direct co-sourced and matrixed resources, and review the quality of their work.

    • Use AI-enabled workflows, continuous controls monitoring, and data analytics to move IT SOX from periodic testing toward scalable, automated assurance.

    Private key management & digital asset controls

    • Own SOX control design and coverage for the full private key lifecycle: generation, storage, access, signing and approval workflows, rotation, backup and recovery, and retirement.

    • Assess controls over key custody architectures, such as HSMs, MPC, multi-signature, and hot/warm/cold wallet structures, including segregation of duties, quorum and approval controls, and privileged access.

    • Evaluate how key management and custody controls support the existence, completeness, and safeguarding of customer and corporate digital assets and their financial reporting implications.

    • Assess controls over on-chain and off-chain transaction processing, reconciliation of wallets to ledgers, and reliance on blockchain data and third-party custodians or service organizations.

    • Be the SOX authority on emerging digital asset risks and decide how the control framework should respond as products, chains, and custody models evolve.

    Deficiency evaluation & remediation

    • Lead evaluation of control deficiencies, including root cause analysis and severity and pervasiveness assessments, and recommend classification (control deficiency, significant deficiency, or material weakness).

    • Own remediation strategy for open ITGC and key management findings. Drive executive-level accountability with Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure leaders.

    • Escalate gaps and delays directly to senior leadership. Report status to the Audit Committee as required.

    • Coordinate with Internal Audit so remediated controls are ready for independent validation.

    Executive & external stakeholder engagement

    • Be the senior SOX voice to the CFO, CISO, CTO, Controller, and the Audit Committee on IT control posture, risks, and remediation.

    • Lead the external auditor relationship on IT matters: audit strategy, reliance and scoping decisions, walkthroughs, and resolution of disagreements.

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to engineering and security leaders, translating audit and control requirements into practical engineering decisions.

    • Partner with Internal Audit, ERM, the business process SOX lead, and co-sourced providers to align coverage across the full assurance program.

    • Mentor SOX and risk team members and raise the technical bar across the function.

 

What you bring

  • 10+ years in SOX compliance, IT audit, internal audit, or external audit, with deep ITGC experience and a record of owning programs at enterprise scale.

  • Direct, hands-on experience with crypto and private key management controls, including designing, assessing, or auditing controls over key custody, wallet infrastructure, signing, and digital asset safeguarding. This is a must-have.

  • Experience in a crypto exchange, custodian, fintech, or payments company with complex, rapidly evolving infrastructure.

  • CISA and CPA certifications required. Candidates with one who are actively pursuing the other will be considered.

  • Expert knowledge of ITGC frameworks, SOX 404, COSO, COBIT, and PCAOB standards, with the judgment to make and defend scoping, reliance, and deficiency-classification decisions.

  • Strong technical fluency in how systems, databases, cloud infrastructure, and deployment pipelines work.

  • Proven ability to connect an ITGC or key management failure to its impact on business process controls and the financial statements.

  • Experience working with external auditors (Big 4 preferred) and presenting to Audit Committees and senior executives.

  • Experience across multi-entity structures or multiple jurisdictions.

  • Exceptional communicator who earns credibility with both engineers and finance executives.

Nice to haves

  • Experience building or scaling an IT SOX program in a growth-stage or first-year SOX company.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD, GitLab or similar version control, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP).

  • Familiarity with SOC 1/SOC 2 reliance for custodians and service providers, and with proof-of-reserves or similar attestations.

  • Familiarity with audit and GRC platforms such as AuditBoard or Workiva.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted compliance tools and willingness to adopt new technologies.

Baton Corporation is the development company that builds and operates the entire technology stack behind pump.fun, the largest memecoin launchpad in production today. The systems are low latency, high throughput, live under constant load, and break if you get them wrong.

About the Role

We're looking for an exceptional talent hunter to find and attract some of the best engineers and operators in the world.

This is a high-impact role working directly with our Head of Talent, with a primary focus on sourcing world-class engineers, alongside exceptional individuals across Product, Finance, Legal, Operations and Marketing.

We have an extremely high bar for talent, and finding the people we're looking for requires more than conventional recruiting methods. We need someone who is relentless in their search, creative in their approach and capable of engaging individuals who aren't actively looking for their next opportunity.

You'll have significant autonomy to develop sourcing strategies, build relationships with outstanding talent and experiment with new ways of finding people others overlook.

This isn't a recruitment coordination or administrative role. Your focus will be on building a sourcing function that consistently delivers exceptional candidates and reduces our reliance on external agencies.

Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are looking for a Lead Product Manager, DeFi to build Bitpanda’s DeFi ecosystem from the ground up, creating the world’s premier Euro-denominated DeFi ecosystem while making it safe, accessible, and intuitive for our customers. 

The first use case is crypto-backed borrowing and lending in the Bitpanda app, with an eye to then build more sophisticated products and use cases leveraging tokenized commodities, securities, funds, and structured products. You’ll decide which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, and work collaboratively to bring DeFi to Bitpanda customers in a way that feels as simple as the app they already trust. You'll work in a small, senior team with our smart contract engineers and Bitpanda's Legal, Compliance and Risk teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product.

What you’ll do 

  • Design and run the lending markets: set loan-to-value and liquidation thresholds, interest rate curves, caps, and oracles, while also owning monitoring and incident playbooks.
  • Bring liquidity and users to permissioned markets and assets: set supply targets, bring in euro liquidity from stablecoin issuers, institutional lenders, curated vaults and market makers, and work out how verified customers reach these markets, without paying for volume.
  • Make sure the right DeFi infrastructure is in place, particularly for permissioned tokenized assets: DEX liquidity deep enough for swaps and liquidations, liquidators, oracles and the other building blocks the markets depend on.
  • Shape what customers see, sign, and own in the Bitpanda app, including how liquidation and risk are explained, and measure real use: borrowers who come back, bad debt and revenue, not total value locked alone.
  • Recommend which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, backed by a business case, and work with Legal, Compliance and Risk from day one on EU consumer credit rules and MiCA.

Who you are 

  • 6+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on building and scaling DeFi or crypto products.
  • You know lending markets in depth: collateral and liquidation mechanics, interest rate models, oracles and how they fail, curation and bad debt. You're at home with the EVM and can read Solidity smart contract code well enough to question engineers about it.
  • Demonstrated experience bringing DeFi applications into regulated consumer products and successfully bridging the gap between decentralized and centralized finance.
  • Ability to lead through influence, build clear business cases, and write excellent documentation in English. This includes a strong working knowledge of EU crypto regulations (e.g., MiCA) to effectively partner with Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams.
  • Nice to haves: 
    • hands-on experience scaling onchain ecosystem liquidity from scratch
    • knowledge of and/or work experience in traditional financial markets

** This position is available in all of our Hubs.


What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

About Notabene

Notabene is on a mission to make crypto a part of the everyday economy. Leading crypto organizations use our tools to reduce transaction risk and make crypto transfers safe. Working across three continents in eight countries, the Notabene team serves our fantastic community of 100+ customers, including financial institutions, fintechs, exchanges, and more. Our co-founders spearheaded foundational Self Sovereign Identity protocols and use-cases. This technology is key to the internals of our cutting edge tech stack.

We’re proud to have the support of leading investors, including Y Combinator, Jump Capital, Castle Island, Green Visor Capital, and more.

We’re at an exhilarating moment in our journey, as regulation technologies (reg-techs) are fast becoming recognized as a vital enabler of the crypto ecosystem. Notabene is growing fast—and we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry!

The Impact You'll Have:

Every crypto transfer we touch moves between institutions that run their own systems, answer to different regulators, and have no reason to trust each other. The software in the middle has to be right every time. A message processed twice, a lost update, or a record shown to the wrong tenant is a compliance failure for our customers.

You’ll work on the core platform that carries this data between institutions around the world, written in Go.

As a Staff Engineer on the team you’ll build the hardest parts of it, contribute to its design, and help the engineers around you do their best work.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build core parts of our transaction platform.

  • Build for correctness under failure, with the isolation and auditability a regulated product needs.

  • Scale the platform as transaction volume and the number of institutions per node grow, keeping latency predictable and the database healthy.

  • Write design docs for what you build, and give sharp, useful reviews on other people’s designs and code.

  • Build with AI agents every day, and help improve the specs, context and review practices that make agent-written code safe to ship in a regulated product.

  • Work with product, compliance and customer-facing teams to turn regulatory and customer needs into working software.

  • Own what you ship in production, from tracing and alerts to incident follow-ups.

  • Mentor engineers on the team.

  • Work on an on call rotation

Must Haves

  • Systems design depth. You’ve designed and owned distributed systems where correctness matters more than features. You know asynchronous processing well and can reason about what happens when parts of it fail.

  • Strong Go, or deep production experience in another statically typed backend language (Java, Kotlin, Rust, C#) and the appetite to be shipping Go within your first weeks.

  • PostgreSQL in depth: schema design, query plans, locking and isolation levels, migrations on live systems, and multi-tenant data.

  • End-to-end ownership in the cloud. Working knowledge of AWS or GCP: IAM, networking, managed databases, queues and storage. You can read and change Terraform and debug production from traces and logs.

  • AI-native engineering. You use coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor every day and can show how. You write the specs and context, break work down for them, and review their output as hard as a human pull request. You know where they fail.

  • Staff-level experience. A track record of delivering large, technically hard projects end to end and helping the engineers around you get better. Typically 8+ years building backend systems.

  • Clear, concise writing in a remote company that makes decisions in documents and async threads.

  • Security fundamentals for sensitive data: encryption in transit and at rest, key handling, minimising personal data, and least-privilege access.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Applied cryptography: encryption, signing and key management.

  • Decentralized identity: DIDs, verifiable credentials, DIDComm.

  • Regulated finance, payments or compliance: Travel Rule, AML, ISO 20022.

  • Building and running software under SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls.

  • Crypto and blockchain knowledge: chains, addresses, assets, CAIP identifiers.

  • Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Queue and workflow systems, and modern observability tooling.

Benefits

  • Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere!

  • $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment.

  • MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs.

  • Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need.

  • Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

Apply Today!

If you strongly believe this role is for you, please apply. Notabene considers a broad array of candidates, including those without blockchain experience. Whether you’re returning to work after a gap in employment, or taking the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar.

Notabene is proud to be an equal employment workplace and an affirmative action employer.
